title: Read a Shopping Message
description: Recognise useful genitive forms in a real shopping message and choose the right item.

data.heading: Read the chunk, not a table
data.body: Notice what follows common quantity words and prepositions. You only need the forms that help you understand and act in this situation.

data.prompt_en: Listen for the task and the reason.
data.transcript_cz: Ahoj, jsem z obchodu. Potřebuju ještě trochu vody, ale nemám čas. Jdu do školy.

questions.question_en: What does the speaker still need?
Why is the speaker in a hurry?

data.prompt_en: Read for the useful details; you do not need to translate every word.
data.text_cz: Ahoj Petro, jsem v obchodě. Máme doma málo mléka a vůbec nemáme jablka. Koupím litr mléka a kilo jablek. Potom jdu z obchodu domů.
data.text_en: Hi Petra, I am in the shop. We have little milk at home and no apples at all. I will buy a litre of milk and a kilo of apples. Then I am going home from the shop.

questions.question_en: Where does the speaker go after the shop?

data.explanation: Use the phrase around the word to understand its meaning.

exercises.answer_key: málo mléka–little milk; kilo jablek–a kilo of apples; z obchodu–from the shop; do školy–to school

data.question_en: There is no milk at home. What do you write?
data.explanation: Máme doma málo mléka is a useful, natural shopping message.
The message uses two familiar quantity chunks.

data.translation_en: Then I am going home from the shop.
data.explanation: Keep z obchodu together as one location chunk.

exercises.prompt: Listen and write the useful update

data.expected_text: Máme doma málo mléka a nemáme jablka.
data.note: Write the complete message, including the useful amount phrase.

exercises.answer_key: Máme doma málo mléka a nemáme jablka.

data.target_text: Jsem v obchodě a koupím kilo jablek.
data.translation_en: I am in the shop and I will buy a kilo of apples.

exercises.answer_key: Jsem v obchodě a koupím kilo jablek.

data.explanation: Give a short useful update before adding extra detail.

exercises.answer_key: Máme doma málo mléka. | Jsem v obchodě.

data.prompt_en: Write a 2–3 sentence message: say where you are, name one thing that is missing, and say what you will buy.
data.sample_answer: Jsem v obchodě. Máme málo mléka. Koupím litr mléka.

exercises.answer_key: Jsem v obchodě. Máme málo mléka. Koupím litr mléka.

data.prompt_en: Record a 15–25 second message. Say where you are, what is needed, and what you will buy.
